Import local SVG file(s) as icons

Usage: wayle icons import <PATH> [NAME]

Arguments:
  <PATH>
          Path to SVG file or directory

  [NAME]
          Icon name (required for single file, ignored for directory)

Options:
  -h, --help
          Print help (see a summary with '-h')

Examples:
    wayle icons import ~/Downloads/my-icon.svg my-icon
        -> cm-my-icon-symbolic

    wayle icons import ~/exported-icons/
        -> Imports all SVGs, preserves names with known prefixes

Icons without a known prefix (tb-, tbf-, si-, md-, ld-) get 'cm-' added.
